physical_conditions.note: Fresh-header payload replay of a 60-packet stale safe segment. Header fields (seq_num, timestamp_ms and host interval) are taken from the concurrent live packet each forged packet replaces, and the HMAC is recomputed, so every packet is ACCEPTED. Cyber-valid, physically stale. Generator v2, header timing fix.

integrity.note: Carrier packets carry their original valid HMAC. A2.3 forged packets carry a freshly computed valid HMAC over the replayed payload (models the IP-F compromised node). Every row verifies under host_receiver logic.

known_limitations: Carrier sensor values are the firmware rand() stub. A2.3 defeats every crypto and freshness check, so communication-layer recall is zero. Forged packets inherit seq_num, timestamp_ms and host interval from the concurrent live packet they replace (generator v2), so header timing and sequence pattern match clean traffic.

The remaining packet-layer signature is content. The source window is seq 1 to W of this same session, so every forged payload exactly repeats an earlier payload in the episode, against roughly 4 percent chance repeats among clean rows on the rand() stub. This is a property of replay itself and is detectable by a payload-history check. It is not a generator artifact, and it weakens if the replayed segment lies outside the detector memory. Physical implausibility against the concurrent load condition needs the real sensor channels (deferred until sensor integration).

deviation_abs and ground_truth_value give the temperature difference from the true concurrent carrier value. Humidity is replayed in the same rows. These are provided for later twin scoring, not as a packet-layer discriminator.
receiver_detection_result is the receiver verdict, carried as a feature, never the label.
